meta.title: Marble Mountains - Not What We Expected! Travel in Da Nang, Vietnam
meta.description:
The Marble Mountains in Da Nang, Vietnam, are a surprising natural wonder. Magnificent marble and limestone peaks tower over the city's shoreline. Beneath these hills lies an expansive network of caves just waiting to be explored. This cluster of mountains is an unexpected gem and a must-see for any Central Vietnam itinerary.
